calibration_sources: HuggingFace FineWeb & FineWeb-Edu (15T Token Deduplication & Educational Classifier Ablations)
NVIDIA NeMo Curator (RAPIDS cuDF/cuGraph GPU-Accelerated MinHash LSH) & Nemotron-CC Synthetic Rephrasing
DataComp-LM (DCLM) & Dolma Pretraining Data Curation Benchmarks

workload.raw_corpus_scale: 100 TB Raw Web + Enterprise Corpus (50 Trillion Raw Tokens -> 5 Trillion Target Pretraining Tokens)
workload.downstream_eval_target: 8B Foundation Model trained for 1T tokens (Baseline GPU pretraining compute budget = $4,000,000)
workload.eval_benchmarks: Macro-average of MMLU (Knowledge), GSM8K (Math Reasoning), and HumanEval (Code)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统规则清洗 + URL/SHA256 精确去重 (C4/OSCAR 基线 -> 38.5% 近似重复垃圾)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Heuristic Rules + Exact URL/SHA256 Dedup (38.5% Residual Near-Duplicates)
tiers.dedup_and_filter_stack: Regex bad-word/length rules + exact document SHA256 hash
tiers.token_quality_strategy: No semantic classifier; misses template boilerplate and SEO spin-articles
tiers.recommended_for: Fast initial raw text ingestion only; unsuitable as final pretraining mix due to 38.5% wasted FLOPs on duplicates.

tiers.name: Tier 2: CPU Spark 全局 MinHash LSH 去重 + Wikipedia KenLM 困惑度过滤 (误杀代码与数学)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: CPU Spark MinHash LSH Fuzzy Dedup + Wikipedia KenLM Perplexity Filter
tiers.dedup_and_filter_stack: CPU Spark 128-perm MinHash LSH all-pairs shuffle + 5-gram KenLM perplexity cutoff
tiers.token_quality_strategy: Removes near-duplicates, but KenLM Wikipedia perplexity discards valid Python code & LaTeX math
tiers.recommended_for: CPU-only general prose corpora; too slow (18.5 days) at 50T scale and harmful to code/math reasoning.

tiers.name: Tier 3: GPU 加速 NeMo Curator (cuDF MinHash + 后缀数组) + FineWeb-Edu 教育价值分类器
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: GPU NeMo Curator (cuDF MinHash + Suffix Array) + FineWeb-Edu Classifier
tiers.dedup_and_filter_stack: RAPIDS cuDF/cuGraph GPU MinHash LSH + Exact Substring Suffix Array + FastText/DeBERTa-v3 0-5 Scorer
tiers.token_quality_strategy: Scores reasoning & educational step-by-step density; discards bottom 90% low-score text
tiers.recommended_for: High-speed open-web curation when raw corpus is abundant (can afford to drop 90% of documents).

tiers.name: Tier 4: GPU NeMo Curator + 质量分桶合成改写 (Nemotron-CC 范式: 3B FP8 将中等脏语料改写为教材)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: GPU NeMo Curator + Quality-Bucketed Synthetic Rephrasing (Nemotron-CC Paradigm)
tiers.dedup_and_filter_stack: GPU cuDF MinHash + 5-Bucket Classifier + vLLM 3B-FP8 Synthetic Rephraser on Middle-Quality Bucket
tiers.token_quality_strategy: Rewrites noisy but fact-rich medium-score docs into structured textbook/Q&A tokens instead of discarding
tiers.recommended_for: Frontier & enterprise domain pretraining needing maximum reasoning accuracy (+23.4 pts) and 2.8x high-IQ token yield under data scarcity.
